## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL; Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive. Confirmation 1: broad sector participation with 9/11 sectors up; Confirmation 2: leadership is concentrated in Technology (narrow), producing offsetting signals that justify NEUTRAL.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Consumer Discretionary leading: AMZN (1W: +16.49% | 1M: +19.91%) ABOVE TREND; Technology strong: NVDA (1W: +10.34% | 1M: +9.02%) ABOVE TREND; Financials solid: JPM (1W: +4.61% | 1M: +10.33%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Energy lagging: XOM (1W: -8.95% | 1M: -4.41%) BELOW TREND and overall Energy weak; Communication under pressure: T (1W: -7.67% | 1M: -6.61%) BELOW TREND; Materials mixed but select names strong (see Top/Bottom).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: LRCX (1W: +21.42% | 1M: +28.37%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +20.60% | 1M: +39.41%) ABOVE TREND, AMZN (1W: +16.49% | 1M: +19.91%) ABOVE TREND, ASML (1W: +16.22% | 1M: +12.83%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +15.21% | 1M: +8.04%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: EOG (1W: -7.38% | 1M: -0.01%) BELOW TREND, T (1W: -7.67% | 1M: -6.61%) BELOW TREND, MPC (1W: -8.76% | 1M: -0.99%) BELOW TREND, XOM (1W: -8.95% | 1M: -4.41%) BELOW TREND, PSX (1W: -9.12% | 1M: -8.09%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Energy and Communications.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W movers: LRCX (1W: +21.42%), INTC (1W: +20.60%), AMZN (1W: +16.49%). Major divergence flagged: several large caps show 1W/1M splits (MSFT, TSLA, JNJ, WMT) — this is a MAJOR divergence; watch for trend breaks rather than assuming continuation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Tech broadly strong but concentrated: NVDA (1W: +10.34% | 1M: +9.02%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: +2.10% | 1M: +3.48%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +5.59% | 1M: -0.62%) POTENTIAL REVERSAL — Sector breadth: 18/24 positive (Sector Strength).

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials constructive with breadth support: JPM (1W: +4.61% | 1M: +10.33%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +2.92% | 1M: +1.38%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +3.16% | 1M: +3.22%) ABOVE TREND — Sector breadth: 15/20 positive (Sector Strength).

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare mixed/defensive tilt: UNH (1W: +2.10% | 1M: +11.38%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +0.71% | 1M: -0.59%) POTENTIAL REVERSAL, LLY (1W: -0.92% | 1M: -6.35%) BELOW TREND — Sector breadth: 10/17 positive (Internal Rotation).

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor exposure to leading Growth/Momentum names in Technology and selective Consumer Discretionary (NVDA, AMZN, META) while reducing exposure to Energy and lagging Communications; leadership narrow so be selective and trim size on names lacking breadth confirmation.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: NVDA (1W: +10.34% | 1M: +9.02%) ABOVE TREND, AMZN (1W: +16.49% | 1M: +19.91%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +21.42% | 1M: +28.37%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: XOM (1W: -8.95% | 1M: -4.41%) BELOW TREND, PSX (1W: -9.12% | 1M: -8.09%) BELOW TREND, T (1W: -7.67% | 1M: -6.61%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Technology (breadth 18/24 positive); Financials (breadth 15/20 positive). BEARISH: Energy (breadth 2/10 positive — Sector Weakness); Communication (breadth 3/10 positive — Internal Rotation).

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA: watch for continuation above near-term resistance (monitor volume for follow-through). AAPL: watch 1M support area for confirmation of ABOVE TREND sustainability. JPM: watch breakout on sustained 1W strength to confirm Financials momentum.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
JNJ (+75): earnings beat and dividend hike; price shows POTENTIAL REVERSAL (1W: +0.71% | 1M: -0.59%) — sentiment bullish but price only modestly confirming. ASML (+75): ASML (1W: +16.22% | 1M: +12.83%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed by strong price action. AVGO (+60): AVGO (1W: +14.02% | 1M: +18.44%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment and price aligned.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
AAPL (-40): Apple (1W: +2.10% | 1M: +3.48%) ABOVE TREND — negative news vs rising price signals potential distribution; monitor. ABT (-45): ABT (1W: -? | 1M: ? ) — note: sentiment negative on legal contest; cross-check price action before adjusting exposure. SYK (-50): SYK (sentiment -50) — price reaction should be watched for downside confirmation.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with Growth/Momentum style; Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive and Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology). NVDA (1W: +10.34% | 1M: +9.02%) ABOVE TREND, AMZN (1W: +16.49% | 1M: +19.91%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +21.42% | 1M: +28.37%) ABOVE TREND. Key risk: narrow Tech-led leadership and MAJOR divergence among large caps (MSFT, TSLA, JNJ showing 1W/1M splits) — watch AAPL news (-40) vs price for distribution.
